# response-format-enforcer

> Validate LLM replies as CSV with typed columns, read-only SQLite SELECT statements or a full-match regex, and re-ask with a bounded correction loop. Python package `trysac-response-format-enforcer`, import name `response_format_enforcer`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the pytest module and what it covers
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): package shape and public API
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): standard-library modules used and discarded options
